title: Error in the critical size approximation
statement: For a natural number $w$, define the critical size error to be $(\log 2)2^w$ minus the critical size at width $w$.
caveat: The definition of critical size is not included in the supplied definitions, so its mathematical meaning cannot be specified more fully.
